notify.title: Project notifications
notify.description: Choose which events are sent to team groups · Each person sets their personal notifications in Profile
notify.closed: This section opens once notifications to LINE groups and Webhooks are ready · For now, each person can set their own notifications in Profile

general.title: General
general.description: Details entered when the project was created. Edit them here
general.goliveBeforeStart: Go-live date can't be before the start date
general.name: Project name
general.keyHint: After changing the Key, old task keys still work as links (redirect)
general.ownerHint: Transfer to someone else in the Danger zone
general.estimateHint: Man-Days of a task with multiple Devs = whole team total · Workload splits it equally per person
general.sizeHint: Choose a Size and Man-Days are filled in for you. You can edit them per task · XL tasks get a suggestion to split into Sub-tasks
general.sizeInherited: Currently using the Workspace values · Edit the numbers and save to set values for this project
general.holidayHint: A Plan Start on a holiday starts counting from the next working day
general.holidayAdminOnly: Only Workspace Admins can change the calendar
general.workHoursHint: Leave blank = use Workspace working hours (1 Man-Day = 8 hrs)
general.timeLogHint: Off by default because the organization already uses an HR system · Progress comes from Man-Days and task status instead · Turn on when you want to compare estimated Man-Days with actual time (adds a Time log tab to tasks)

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.description: Task statuses, their order and status transition rules · Can differ per task type
workflow.bugColumnsHint: The board uses the standard Workflow columns · Bug cards show their real status name · Filter to Bugs only and the board switches to Bug columns
workflow.footer: You can delete a status that has tasks. You'll be asked which status to move them to · Kanban shows columns in this order
workflow.removeHasIssues: This status has {count, plural, one {{count} task} other {{count} tasks}} · Choose a status to move them to
workflow.removeEmpty: No tasks in this status. It can be deleted right away

types.title: Task types
types.description: Turn types on/off and set required fields
types.standardHint: On every task and can't be removed · Used to calculate Workload, Gantt and Requirement Traceability
types.requiredHint: Task title is always required · Selected fields must be filled in before creating this task type
types.removeFieldHint: This field's values will be removed from every task
types.removeLabelHint: This Label will be removed from every task

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Reorder with the arrow buttons · This order is used in Table, Timeline and filters
modules.emptyDescription: Add Modules to group tasks on the Table and Timeline pages
modules.name: Module name
modules.removeHasIssues: This Module has {count, plural, one {{count} task} other {{count} tasks}} · Choose a Module to move them to (the task group of moved tasks is cleared)
modules.removeEmpty: No tasks in this Module. It can be deleted right away

perms.title: Permissions by Role
perms.description: Applies to members of this project only
perms.hint: Admins always have every permission · Workspace-level Guests can be a Viewer or Member in a project, as invited · Client Guests only see Overview, Timeline and tasks shared with them (no names, Workload or Bugs) · Guests who are Members can't invite people, even if "Invite members to project" is enabled for Members
perms.defaultsNote: The table starts from the system defaults · Values changed earlier can't be shown here yet, but the system always uses the most recently saved values

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Actions in this section affect everyone in the project
danger.archiveHint: Hidden from the Sidebar. Everyone can still open it read-only. Can be restored
danger.restoreHint: This project is archived · Restore it to edit again
danger.transferHint: Hand over the Project Owner role to another member
danger.noCandidates: No members can receive ownership yet (must be a non-Guest project member)
danger.deleteImpact: Deletes {issues} tasks, {files} files, {members} members and all history · Only the Workspace Owner can restore it within {days} days
danger.deleteOwnerOnly: Only the Project Owner or a Workspace Admin can delete

4.description: Invite members and set permissions and capacity for the Workload chart (optional)

5.description: Defaults work right away. Edit them later in Project Settings (optional)
